card.name: Digits in numeric ranges and measurements
card.fires_on: The first digit of a number in a range or measurement, such as a time span, a distance or a size, where a unit word like minutes, hours, days, years or feet comes next.

modes.label: Range of times
modes.description: A digit starting a time figure in a 'from X to Y' span of minutes, hours or days.
modes.example: sildenafil tablets may be taken anywhere from <<3>>0 minutes to 4 hours before sexual

modes.label: Physical size
modes.description: A number or unit word in a height or dimension, such as feet or inches.

card.plain: It fires on the opening digit of a number that is about to be followed by a unit such as minutes, hours, years or feet.
